surface_mechanism_description: The ALD process uses molybdenum hexacarbonyl (Mo(CO)6) and hexamethyldisilathiane (HMDST) as precursors. The surface reaction mechanism involves the sequential exposure of the sapphire substrate to Mo(CO)6 and HMDST vapors, leading to the formation of MoS2 layers. The exact chemical equations for the surface reactions are not explicitly provided in the text.
